request: How to save context on heavy sessions — context gets lost or items missed after compacting conversations
approach: Three targeted changes to CLAUDE.md and herald.config.json: (1) add retry_context and dependency_notes fields to the plan file schema, (2) mandate atomic per-item writes before next dispatch, (3) lower context checkpoint threshold to 60% and add a resume diff gate to the Context Harvester.

checklist.task: Add retry_context and dependency_notes fields to plan file schema in CLAUDE.md
checklist.output: Added retry_context and dependency_notes fields to checklist item schema in CLAUDE.md Plan File Schema section.
checklist.risk_summary: Modifies CLAUDE.md spec — existing plans do not have these fields but are backward compatible (null defaults).
checklist.safe_default: Add fields as optional with null defaults.

checklist.task: Update Layer 5 Output Capture — require full item write before next agent is dispatched
checklist.output: Updated Output Capture section in Layer 5 to mandate atomic write of output, error, and retry_context before next agent dispatch.
checklist.risk_summary: Modifies dispatch instruction — adds a blocking write step between agent completion and next dispatch.
checklist.dependency_notes: Depends on item 1 — retry_context field must exist in schema before write instruction references it.

checklist.task: Lower context_checkpoint_at from 0.75 to 0.60 in herald.config.json
Update Layer 2 Context Harvester — add resume diff gate on in-progress plan detection
checklist.output: Updated Layer 2 Context Harvester to diff plan file against current context on resume, re-injecting completed items not reflected in conversation state.
checklist.risk_summary: Modifies resume behavior — adds a structured re-injection step before continuing dispatch.
checklist.safe_default: Re-inject all completed items as structured summary before proceeding.
checklist.dependency_notes: Depends on items 1 and 2 — retry_context and dependency_notes must exist in plan files for the diff to surface them.
